retained_results.exact_retained_result: HemK has NPPY at residue 183; Dam has DPPY at residue 181. The best local alignment instead covered only 19 residue pairs, with 7 identities and raw score 38, and did not pair those two motifs.
M.TaqI contains NPPY at residue 105. Its optimal alignment to HemK had 104 aligned residue pairs, 30 identities, 13 gap characters and raw score 47; the shared NPPY aligned at the end of the region.

There were 4403 FASTA records. HemK P0ACC1 ranked first nonself with raw score 254; next was TrmN6 P31825 at 103, then RsmC P39406 at 92. Three selenoproteins contained U outside BLOSUM62 and were scored after masking U to X; their identities are recorded in the score artifact.

The alignment spans HemK residues 48-239 and PrmB residues 70-263, with 192 aligned residue pairs, 63 identities, two gap characters and raw score 254. Both NPPY motifs align within a wider shared region.
